storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/treasuryauctions/ (gz after 2 days)
written_by: server/treasuryAuctions.ts archiveAuctions (6h poll over a 30-day window, eager boot)
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'U.S. Department of the Treasury'

field_map.cusip + auction_date: dedup key — results are immutable; reopenings share a cusip but auction on new dates
field_map.type/term: Bill | Note | Bond | TIPS | FRN | CMB, with securityTerm
field_map.high_yield / high_discount_rate / high_i: whichever the security class carries; the others stay null, never guessed (bills = discount/investment rate, coupons = yield)
field_map.dealer_take: DERIVED: primary_dealer_accepted / competitive_accepted — dealers absorbing what investors won't; null when either input is absent

confidence_model: RAW official auction results (one DERIVED ratio, labeled). HONESTY: the classic tail-vs-when-issued stress metric needs a 1pm-ET WI quote, which is PAID data — the free stress metrics are bid_to_cover + bidder-class shares, and nothing here claims to be a tail. Rows appear only once results publish (pre-result announcements are skipped, picked up on a later poll).
cadence: 6h poll; auctions settle ~1pm ET on auction days (~250 auctions/yr)
